script: [Short] Called my bank, was told they couldn't do anything, emailed every important-sounding staff on their website, problem fixed in less than 10 minutes. I made a mistake and placed two orders online when the page loaded weird and didn't appear to process my payment, even though it had. The payment got stuck, but the seller canceled one order as soon as I told them. The money was on hold for a week, over five business days, and that's when I started feeling the heat. but here's the thing… I called the bank, and they said the hold would last until July 31. They also said there was nothing they could do, which made me feel like a total idiot. I tried to explain the situation, but they just kept repeating the same line. what I didn't know was… I called the payee, and they were super nice. They confirmed they had canceled the payment and had no idea why July 31 was on the docket. I tried calling the bank again, hoping someone would actually listen. until And that's the end of the story.
